theorem.name: Q79DeterminantFreeKernelAndPrimitiveRepairTheorem
theorem.statement: The q79 Mukai block has unique primitive determinant-free combination 3a-b=(8,0,-1), but that vector lies in Yoshioka's all-non-locally-free class. Adding the length-two ideal charge gives the primitive locally-free-admissible vector (9,0,-2) with c2=11; identifying that repair with q7=2 remains a source-map premise.
